definitions.explanation: Describes an object designed to be tall and narrow, or oriented top-to-bottom, as opposed to wide and low. Common for appliances, blinds, and screen layouts.

examples.japanese: {縦型|たてがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗濯機|せんたくき}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a vertical-type washing machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縦型|たてがた}⟦ブラインド→ブラインド：04890_buraindo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けている→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I have vertical blinds fitted to the window.

examples.japanese: スマートフォン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦型|たてがた}のまま⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I shot the video with the smartphone screen kept in portrait orientation.

notes:
⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧ (vertical) + {型|がた} (type): describes anything built or oriented lengthwise, top-to-bottom.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦型|たてがた}⟦ブラインド→ブラインド：04890_buraindo⟧: vertical blinds
- {縦型|たてがた}⟦{洗濯機|せんたくき}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧: top-loading (vertical-drum) washing machine
- {縦型|たてがた}⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: portrait-orientation screen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{横型|よこがた}→横型：30884_yokogata⟧: horizontal-type — the direct opposite orientation
